description: This file defines the AppointmentService class, providing methods to interact with the 'appointments' table in a database via the SupabaseService. It includes methods for listing appointments for patients and doctors, retrieving by ID, creating, updating, and cancelling appointments.

classes.name: AppointmentService
classes.description: A service class providing CRUD operations for appointment data in the database.

methods.name: listForPatient
methods.description: Retrieves a list of appointments for a specific patient.

methods.name: listForDoctor
methods.description: Retrieves a list of appointments for a specific doctor.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Gets an appointment by its unique ID.
